name: Apart Chamins
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The Apart Chamins is a holiday home in Tirol, Austria. The accommodation is located in a peaceful setting and serves as a starting point for activities in the surrounding area. The holiday apartments feature a separate kitchen and a living area. A garden and parking spaces are available. There is a secure storage room for skis and bicycles. Free Wi-Fi is provided in public areas. The region offers opportunities for hiking in the summer and skiing in the winter. This house is ideal for guests seeking an independent holiday.
